headerDisplay: Modern Homebridge plugin for Somfy Protect home security systems. For help and documentation please see the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jay-d-tyler/homebridge-somfy-protect).
footerDisplay: 💡 **Tip:** After saving, check your Homebridge logs to see detected sites. If you have multiple sites, copy the site ID and add it to Advanced Settings.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name that will appear in your Homebridge log.

username.title: Email Address
username.description: Your Somfy Protect account email (same as Somfy mobile app)

oauthClientId.title: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.description: Client ID for an OAuth client authorized to use the Somfy Protect API.

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauthClientSecret.description: Secret for the configured Somfy Protect OAuth client.

siteId.title: Site ID
siteId.description: 🏠 For multiple Somfy Protect sites: After saving, check logs to see all detected sites with their IDs. Copy the site ID you want to use and paste it here.

pollingInterval.title: Normal Polling Interval
pollingInterval.description: ⏱️ How often to check alarm status when stable (milliseconds). Default: 60000 (60 seconds).

adaptivePolling.title: Enable Adaptive Polling
adaptivePolling.description: 🚀 Automatically poll faster after state changes for quicker updates, then slow down when stable. Reduces API calls while staying responsive.

fastPollingInterval.title: Fast Polling Interval
fastPollingInterval.description: ⚡ How often to check status after a state change (milliseconds). Default: 1000 (1 second). Only used when Adaptive Polling is enabled.

fastPollingDuration.title: Fast Polling Duration
fastPollingDuration.description: ⏲️ How long to use fast polling after a state change (milliseconds). Default: 60000 (60 seconds). After this, returns to normal polling.

httpPort.title: 🌐 HTTP API Port
httpPort.description: Port for the HTTP API used by automation integrations. 0 (default) disables the API. Note: 8581 is usually taken by the Homebridge UI — pick another port, e.g. 8582.

httpToken.title: 🔒 HTTP API Token
httpToken.placeholder: Required when HTTP API is enabled
httpToken.description: Required when HTTP API Port is non-zero. Requests must include an 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN' header.

httpHost.title: HTTP API Bind Address
httpHost.description: Network address for the HTTP API. Keep 127.0.0.1 for same-host integrations. Use 0.0.0.0 only when LAN access is required.
